France Selects Russian-Language Film 'Minotaur' for Oscar Consideration

France has chosen the Russian-language film 'Minotaur' as its official selection to compete for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film. The film, described as an unflinching portrait of moral decay, is France's submission for the prestigious award. Details regarding the film's plot or specific themes beyond its critical reception were not provided in the coverage.
